steps.text: Non-stick pan, dry, medium-high. Spinach in (100/120 g) with a pinch of salt. 60 seconds, until it collapses. Tip onto a plate and press the water out with the back of a spoon.
Oil into the pan — rapeseed, it is about to fry (5/8 g). Beat the eggs (100 g — 2 eggs) with black pepper. Pour in and tilt to coat the base.
Leave 45 seconds untouched. As the edge sets, draw it to the middle with a spatula and tilt again. Twice more — you want three or four soft folds, not scramble.
Spinach over one half, cheddar on top (15/20 g). Fold, lid on, heat OFF. 60 seconds to melt.
Warm the tortilla (45/50 g) 20 seconds a side in the dry pan while that happens.
Tomato (80/100 g) sliced thin and salted. Avocado (35/45 g) mashed onto the tortilla. Egg in, tomato on, hot sauce, fold and press.

why: Wilt and squeeze. Spinach is mostly water and it will steam the eggs into a wet mess otherwise. And take the pan off the heat before the cheese goes on — residual heat melts it and the egg stays tender.
notes: D0-003: the pan-frying oil (whole 5/8 g figure — a single hot-pan use, no dressing/finishing use in this dish) becomes rapeseed_oil throughout.
